name: Tyres, Wheels & TPMS
disclaimer: Tyres are the vehicle's only contact point with the road. Driving on severely damaged or deflated tyres can lead to fatal blowouts.

symptoms: Tyre flat or losing PSI rapidly
Car pulling hard to one side
subtopics.criticalWarning: Do not drive on a completely flat tyre even for short distances—this destroys the alloy wheel rim and tyre sidewall internally.
triageQuestions: Is the puncture located on the center tread or on the sidewall/shoulder?
Do you have a spare tyre, jack, or tyre sealant inflator kit?
subtopics.recommendedAction: Sidewall punctures cannot be safely plugged and require tyre replacement. Center tread punctures may be repaired with internal patch-plug.

symptoms: TPMS warning light illuminated or blinking
One or more tyre pressures low
triageQuestions: Is the TPMS light solid (low pressure) or flashing for 60 seconds (sensor error)?
Have you checked tyre pressures cold with a pressure gauge?
subtopics.recommendedAction: Inspect tyre pressure cold according to driver door jamb placard; recalibrate TPMS or replace sensor.

symptoms: Steering wheel or seat vibration at 50-70 mph
triageQuestions: Does the vibration start only at higher speeds?
Do you see smooth wear on the inner or outer tread edge?
subtopics.recommendedAction: Wheel balance, 4-wheel laser alignment, and tyre rotation.

triageRules: Sidewall damage/bulges are immediate blowout hazards -> DO NOT DRIVE.
Advise maintaining minimum 2/32 inch (1.6mm) legal tread depth.
